controls.depthPlacementHint: Standard: the scene straddles the screen plane for stronger depth; near objects pop out, which can cause window violations at the left/right frame edges. Window-safe: the nearest subject is placed slightly behind the screen, so nothing pops out.
controls.geometricRefineHint: Experimental: corrects residual roll / vertical-zoom difference while preserving depth. AKAZE or SIFT recommended.
